entry.author: Parliamentary Commissioner for the Environment
entry.summary: The New Zealand Parliament holds Scrutiny Week twice a year, it is designed to hold the government accountable by examining government spending and performance. Select committees review what public entities have achieved. The Commissioner for the Environment, Simon Upton, along with his Chief Financial Officer Helen Mallon and Chief Advisor Geoff Simmons presented at the Environment Committee on 18 June 2026.
